rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an ornamental fountain in a garden, park, or public place.

example.english: The fountain in the park lights up at night.
example.traditional: 公園嗰個噴水池夜晚會著燈。
example.jyutping: gung1 jyun4 go2 go3 pan3 seoi2 ci4 je6 maan5 wui5 zoek6 dang1

rows.note: Use this for naturally flowing spring water rather than an artificial ornamental fountain.

example.english: The fountain here is natural spring water flowing out of the mountain.
example.traditional: 呢度嘅泉水係由山入面流出嚟嘅。
example.jyutping: nei1 dou6 ge3 cyun4 seoi2 hai6 jau4 saan1 jap6 min6 lau4 ceot1 lei4 ge3

rows.note: Use this for the soda dispenser or fountain equipment found in an American-style food-service setting.

example.english: The soda fountain at that American-style fast-food restaurant is broken.
example.traditional: 嗰間美式快餐店嘅汽水機壞咗。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 mei5 sik1 faai3 caan1 dim3 ge3 hei3 seoi2 gei1 waai6 zo2
